perspectives.name: discovery-weak-signals
observations: L3Harris received an undefinitized $4.7 billion seven-year PAC-3 MSE propulsion award announced 2026-09-08, a material signal of sustained missile-defense production demand.

A July 2026 Space Development Agency award for 18 missile-tracking satellites extends demand across space-based missile defense, while a September Air Force sensor award shows continued munitions-component production breadth.

perspectives.name: expectations-execution
observations: The company is explicitly expanding propulsion and sensor capacity to meet higher defense demand; a July framework also targeted quadrupling THAAD propulsion production.
Large awards provide multi-year production visibility, but undefinitized/framework awards still require conversion into executed production, delivery and economics.

risks: Undefinitized or framework awards can change before final terms.
Rapid capacity expansion creates execution, supplier and capital-intensity risk.
Government-program concentration and procurement timing remain material dependencies.
unknowns: Final economics and margin profile of the $4.7 billion PAC-3 award are not established here.
Capacity-ramp timing versus contracted delivery requirements remains unverified.
